description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 metric for four different approaches to conversation recommendation. The horizontal axis displays the category labels: “Ours”, “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”, presented in an unspecified order. The vertical axis is labeled “Recall@10” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are four individual bars, each a different shade of blue or orange. The “Ours” bar is orange and extends to approximately 0.33. The “- critiquing” bar is blue and reaches approximately 0.28. The “- scoring” bar is also blue, with a height of approximately 0.17, and the “- ranking” bar is the shortest blue bar, extending to approximately 0.23. No bars are visually emphasized, and there are no groupings or stacking of bars present.
